flat_zero_volume_reassessment.new_assessment: Flat zero-volume candles are not by themselves proof of stale data. In the fresh capture, public trades are sparse; in the inspected fully covered active bars, UDF OHLC matches trade-derived OHLC while UDF volume is exactly 2x trade quantity. Keep flat-zero bars as a freshness/market-inactivity observation, not a standalone failure, unless candle timestamps exceed the approved freshness threshold or a trade occurs without a candle update.
flat_zero_volume_reassessment.previous_observation_was_flagged_as_poss: yes; retained in earlier evidence manifest without mutation
flat_zero_volume_reassessment.primary_blocker: volume semantics mismatch across UDF candles, latest-trades API and market 24h volume remains unresolved.

gate_disposition.flat_zero_volume_candles: NOT_A_STANDALONE_FAILURE; many align with minutes with no trade; retain freshness checks
gate_disposition.reconnect: LIVE_TRANSPORT_RECONNECT_AND_DISTINCT_SESSIONS_OBSERVED; deterministic epoch guard PASS; production collector isolation NOT VERIFIED because no Wallex WS collector is wired/enabled
gate_disposition.visual_render: NO_INDEPENDENT_PIXEL_SCREENSHOT; source-level frontend mapping confirms chart uses the same UDF OHLCV payload
gate_disposition.volume_semantics: BLOCKED_UDF_V_IS_EXACTLY_2X_PUBLIC_TRADE_QUANTITY_IN_99_FULLY_COVERED_1M_BARS_ACROSS_5_SYMBOLS; rolling 24h UDF volume also near 2x market 24h_volume; requires exchange semantics clarification before volume-based feature promotion

observed_volume_semantics.interpretation: Official docs describe UDF v as candle trading volume and trade quantity as amount traded. The consistent 2x difference is an unresolved upstream semantics/data-quality discrepancy. Do not silently halve v or treat it as normal without Wallex clarification; volume-dependent feature acceptance remains blocked.
observed_volume_semantics.observed_ratio: UDF v / sum(public trade quantity) = exactly 2 in every fully covered bar tested

quality_gate_boundary_tests.note: These deterministic tests validate the stated threshold rules, not a production runtime clock monitor. HTTP Date remains coarse and is not independent NTP/monotonic attestation.

quality_gate_policy_proposal_not_approve.clock: HTTP Date offset absolute >2 seconds warns and >5 seconds blocks pending independent NTP/monotonic-clock validation; Date granularity is 1 second
quality_gate_policy_proposal_not_approve.freshness: Closed 1m candle age 0..120 seconds; closed 1h age 0..7200 seconds; future or stale data blocks promotion
quality_gate_policy_proposal_not_approve.gaps: Every adjacent closed candle timestamp must differ by exact interval; any gap blocks promotion and no synthetic candles are created
quality_gate_policy_proposal_not_approve.reconnect: Each socket session receives unique ID/epoch; parser/subscription state is session-scoped; reject any delayed prior-epoch event; log session ID on every accepted event

quality_gate_sample_evaluation.interpretation: The sampled values pass the proposed rules, but thresholds remain unapproved and HTTP Date is coarse.

raw_evidence_bundle.assembly: Concatenate the part files in ascending numeric order without separators, then base64-decode the concatenated text to obtain the gzip tar archive.
raw_evidence_bundle.encoding: base64-encoded gzip tar; decode then extract

reconnect_evidence.interpretation: Two live WebSocket sessions connected and received depth frames; server session IDs differ. No trade frames arrived during these short windows, consistent with the REST trade snapshot showing no new trade since 16:15:34Z. The epoch guard rejects delayed prior-session events in a deterministic harness. This is not a production collector integration test because no Wallex WS collector is wired/enabled. Raw received frames are retained in adjacent JSONL.

live_trade_reconnect_followup.interpretation: Two 45-second live trade-only sessions had distinct server session IDs but no @trade frames. This cannot validate stale trade-frame rejection because no trade event arrived; retain the prior depth-frame reconnect evidence and keep production collector isolation unverified.

rolling_24h_volume_crosscheck.interpretation: Window boundaries differ from the rolling 24h stats window, so the ratio is supporting evidence only; it is near 2x and consistent with the exact trade/candle volume ratio observed in fully covered bars.

scope: read-only public market APIs and official Wallex chart frontend source; no credentials, order/account mutations, production collector activation, or runtime changes
